guarded_patterns.explanation: Force push would rewrite public history

redirect.reason_template: git push --force would rewrite public history. Use --force-with-lease instead.

guarded_patterns.explanation: Force push with -f flag would rewrite public history

redirect.reason_template: git push -f would rewrite public history. Use --force-with-lease instead.

guarded_patterns.explanation: Commit without explicit path specification can sweep in unintended changes

redirect.reason_template: git commit without explicit path specification (--all, --message, paths) can sweep in unintended changes from the working tree. Specify paths explicitly: git commit path/to/file path/to/other/file
